artifacts.title: Adapter Declaration
artifacts.description: Self-description an enforcement-runtime adapter presents when registering with the control plane.

artifacts.title: Canonical Enforcement Decision
artifacts.description: Closed vocabulary every adapter normalizes a runtime's native verdict into.

artifacts.title: Evidence Erasure Request
artifacts.description: Body accepted by the evidence erasure endpoint (right-to-erasure workflows).

artifacts.title: Decision Evaluation Request
artifacts.description: Body accepted by POST /api/v1/decision/evaluate: a proposed action submitted for a governance decision.

artifacts.title: Generic Evidence Field Mapping
artifacts.description: Declarative mapping that projects an arbitrary runtime payload onto the canonical evidence shape.

artifacts.title: Evidence Ingest Request
artifacts.description: Body accepted by POST /api/v1/evidence: one governed runtime action recorded as evidence.

artifacts.title: Runtime Stack
artifacts.description: Closed vocabulary of enforcement runtimes an evidence record or decision may originate from.

artifacts.title: Gateway Decision Request
artifacts.description: Body accepted by POST /api/gateway/decide: the pre-action check a governed agent makes before acting.

artifacts.title: Gateway Resolution Request
artifacts.description: Body accepted when resolving a previously escalated gateway decision.

artifacts.title: Git Checkpoint Ingest Request
artifacts.description: Body accepted when recording a git checkpoint as evidence of an agent's change.

artifacts.title: Spctre API
artifacts.description: OpenAPI 3.1 description of the public /api/v1/ surface. The version segment is `info.version`, which is frozen; revisions within it are identified by the spec's `x-spctre-spec-revision`.

artifacts.title: Spctre Managed Governance Policy Bundle
artifacts.description: Hand-authored JSON Schema for the compiled policy bundle an enforcement runtime loads.

artifacts.title: Token Pair Response
artifacts.description: Access/refresh token pair returned by the token endpoints.

artifacts.title: Token Refresh Request
artifacts.description: Body accepted when exchanging a refresh token for a new access token pair.
